report:
Initial stage: SS hydration is independently repeated in two credited retailer accounts, A04 and A08, under different conditions: pre-makeup use with lightweight, refreshing, fast-drying hydration and no clogged-pore feeling; and use alongside tretinoin and other actives on self-described challenging skin at age 51. This supports reported hydration, not measured efficacy, universal suitability, or a particular formula version. Neither account independently corroborates the other's more specific benefits. No direct opposing hydration report appears in the available text; A07's body is unavailable, not negative or positive evidence.

A09 separately reports hydration retention from Avant Guard plus SS, with no separable allocation of the joint result. Its small-head/nose fit complaint and one-star deduction coexist with praise for retention. A10 concerns Buffer Jelly retaining unspecified hydrating products overnight and producing morning glow; it does not establish SS hydration or SS use.

Texture evidence is mixed in description, without establishing a direct contradiction: A04 calls SS lightweight and fast-drying, while A03 finds Wave Serum less sticky than SS. Different attributes, comparators and unspecified application conditions could coexist. The specific stickiness comparison is one first-hand report, not independently repeated. A03's independence posture is unavailable. A03 continues using SS despite relative stickiness, attributing this to a tentative belief that it contains more glycerin; that belief is not verified composition or hydration evidence. No available focal account supplies non-user texture speculation.

Behavior: A04 explicitly narrates ordering SS after introduction by a sister, buying Buffer Jelly for greater nighttime hydration/repair, then buying face wash and the mesh moisturizer. These are individual reported purchases, not proof that SS hydration caused every subsequent purchase. Buffer Jelly's morning glow/clean-skin result and face wash's reported makeup removal, hydration and cessation of breakouts remain other-product claims. A04 also values the packaging colors. Refill metadata does not establish an additional repurchase. No focal account explicitly reports a return, refund or corrective remedy.

Engagement: A03 has native Reddit score 6, supplied as material_positive=false and not interpreted; A04/A07/A08/A09/A10 each have 0 up-votes and 0 down-votes, observation times unavailable. These supply no established material resonance and cannot count as experiences, independence, prevalence or buying effects. There are no bare agreeing focal replies. Distinct source-account counts below are not origin or event counts; source roles do not establish cross-venue corroboration of a shared precise benefit here.

Material context, outside focal counts: Reddit parent hillary_____k (2025-01-16, score 24; observation time unavailable) reports a Black Friday Level Serum purchase, brighter/even skin and emphatic future repurchase intention—not completed repurchase and not SS testimony. The enclosing post asks about Regimenlab after Instagram advertising; its actor and engagement are unavailable. Product-page and metadata contexts resolve review targets and self-reported skin types, but add no experience or independent origins. All formula versions are unknown; target labels identify review variants, not necessarily the SKU used in every narrated experience.

Only the initial stage was supplied. A second-stage comparison cannot be reported, and A07's literal 'undefined...' cannot be reconstructed from metadata.
